notes: Known-answer typed-decision questions for decide-* profiles, asked through the PRODUCTION Go driver of the profile's protocol (`llmctl-decide smoke --question-file`, letter-logit / nli-onnx / systemone-native) against the profile's own engine; the judge compares the returned choice key exactly (choice_equals) and repeats every question (LLMCTL_VALIDATE_REPEAT, default 3): the choice AND the probabilities must be byte-identical. How the expectations were derived: every question has exactly one defensible answer BY CONSTRUCTION - the state or the option text states it literally (invoice_team is the exact question of the post-download decision smoke, internal/gateway/smoke.go smokeBody); the right answer is the first option in two questions and the second in three, so a model that always picks one position fails. EXECUTION STATUS: unexecuted - no decision model can be run on the authoring host (live operator services, host safety), so these expectations have never been confirmed against a real decide-* engine; until a live PASS is recorded under docs/qa a profile on this suite is reported by `llmctl validate-all` as NOT VALIDATED. jev-verdict (decide-tiny) is implemented by no driver: its validation is UNDETERMINED by design.
